subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Then it becomes a clue.”?
options: A living classroom changes every time students enter it.
When too much enters it, the whole balance changes.
Shared words can guide people when they are taken seriously.
Cities remember through words, even when the ground changes.
